official_pdf.note: Official PDF URL on bir-cdn/bir.gov.ph returned HTTP 403/404; provenance SHA-256 and page count read from html-frozen/2550m-2007/provenance.json. Visual inspection performed against the rendered print pages and frozen HTML geometry.

summary: Schedule rows cannot be added through form.fill (131 schedule keys refused as written through the form's own editors) or reliably persisted through the UI Add row dialog (Schedule 2's Date Purchased column is omitted from the dialog and clicking Done after filling Description, Amount, and Input Tax leaves 'No rows yet'); on print, Page 1 Item 9 Registered Address hard-clips 'METRO MAN' at the right border, Item 11 special-tax specify prints blank despite Yes + special rate selected, computed 12% output/input tax boxes (13B, 18F, 18H, 18J, 18L, 18O) print 0.00 for non-zero bases, and Page 2 Schedule 1/2/3/4/5/6/7/8 totals and cells have microscopic (~5pt) and inconsistent left/right alignment.

test_data.profile: Juana Santos long-name/long-address demo profile (TIN 000-123-453-00000, RDO 008)
test_data.notes: 27/27 main-form fields applied via form.fill; 131 schedule keys (Schedules 2, 3A, 3B, 6, 7, 8) were refused by form.fill as editor-owned. Scripted UI Add row attempted 6 rows in Schedule 2 (2 rows past its 4 printed rows); the dialog omitted cell-0 (Date Purchased) and saved 0 rows.

defects.description: Schedule 2–8 rows cannot be populated via form.fill (refused as written through the form's own editors), and in the UI Schedule 2 'Add row' dialog the first column (Date Purchased, cell-0) is missing; filling Description, Amount (Net of VAT), and Input Tax and pressing Done six times leaves 'No rows yet' and all Schedule 2 print rows blank (blocking schedule overflow past 4 printed rows).
Part I Item 9 Registered Address shrinks to ~5pt and hard-clips at the right edge of the single-line box ('...MAKATI CITY, METRO MAN', cutting off 'ILA').

Part II computed VAT output/input tax boxes 13B, 18F, 18H, 18J, 18L, and 18O all display and print 0.00 even when their taxable bases (13A = 15,000,000.00; 18E = 34,567,890.00; 18G = 12,345,678.50; 18I = 8,765,432.25; 18K = 4,321,098.75; 18N = 1,543,210.50) are filled.
Part I Item 11 'If yes, specify' prints blank even though Amended/Special Tax Relief = Yes and option '1' (special_rate) are selected.

Header Item 3 Number of Sheets Attached ('10') renders microscopic (~4-5pt) with '1' clipped against the left border of the first slot and '0' floating high in the second slot; Item 2 Amended Return 'X' is tiny and off-center.

Page 2 Schedule 4 and Schedule 5 right-hand amount columns have inconsistent font size and alignment: the top '0.00' row renders microscopic (~5pt) and left-aligned, while the rows beneath it render normal size and right-aligned; Schedule 1 ATC ('VB010') and Schedule 1/2/3/6/7/8 total '0.00' cells also print microscopic (~5pt) and top-aligned.
Official BIR Form 2550M PDF has 4 pages (Pages 3–4 are Guidelines/Instructions); the app renders 2 form pages.
